<$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>Good grief, are you really so weak you can’t handle a silly
little chain? Are you eating well enough?!

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>I daresay you’re not really in a position to say such
things.
<$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Either way, eating a meal or two won’t make a difference—
that chain is simply too hard!

<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,7)>E-excuse me, but if you’re mocking the power of cooking,
I simply won’t stand for it!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,9)>If you eat MY dishes, you’ll find yourself with one hundred
times your usual energy!
<$voicel(2,7)>Any move a Pokémon uses will become one hundred times
stronger as well. A mere chain wouldn’t stand a chance
against that!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Are you just making things up because you can’t get out
of that barrel yourself?

<$comeff(2,22)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,9)>No, it’s the truth! UGH, this is so frustrating...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, I know! How about this—I teach you how to make my
dishes, and you do the cooking! <$voicel(2,6)>I’m really an excellent
teacher, you know!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,7)>You might not make something that gives you one hundred
times your strength, but surely you can manage 10 times!
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>You’re asking us to cook, now? <wait(0.5)>Hmmm.

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>What do you say, <$cdef(27)>? I can’t think
of
any
better
plan,
I’m afraid.
<$voicel(1,7)>And you have such a talent for creating things, like the
humans did, <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>so maybe you can cook as well!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>So you’ll do it? Thank you! I won’t forget this kindness!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Now then, let’s start with the basics: a <$cdef(27)>salad. I’ll sing the
instructions to you, so listen closely!

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>So you’ll do it? Thank you! I won’t forget this kindness!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Now then, let’s start with the basics: a salad. I’ll sing the
instructions to you, so listen closely!
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,4)>You’ll...sing?

<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,7)>Chop-chop, chop ’em up, all those <$cdef(27)><$ifull(565)> of green! ♪
Chop ’em on a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)>, smooth and clean!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,10)>Flop-flop, toss-toss, put ’em on a plaaate! ♪
Now you have a saaalad—tasty, green, and great!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>What was THAT?
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Salad Song, Opus Number One, of course!
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Those were awfully vague instructions...

<$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,5)>Yes, well, it’s the very first recipe for beginners! Anyway,
let’s get back on track...
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,7)>Please make yourself a smooth, clean <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)>.
<$voicel(2,5)>Once you’ve got one, you basically just chop up some
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(565)> and you’re done!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I suppose we could make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)> by hacking
off a piece of a log...

<$comeff(2,7)><$voicel(2,4)>No, no, that won’t do at all! You can’t be so rough and
careless!
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,7)>A <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)> has to be perfectly smooth! <$voicel(2,6)>Making
one is a delicate and beautiful undertaking.

<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,4)>Hrmmm, you’ve certainly got a lot of requests.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Now, let’s see... What Pokémon could cut a board
delicately and beautifully?
<$comeff(1,20)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Aha! This may be a task for <$cdef(27)>Dartrix!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)><$cdef(27)>, do you think you could find
a <$cdef(27)>Dartrix?
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>I believe they tend to like homes like this.

<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>First of all, you need a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)>!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,645)><$voicel(2,5)>Go ask that sweetie <$cdef(27)>Dartrix to teach you how to make one!

<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You may recall that we need a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)> to make
a <$cdef(27)>salad. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>First, try to find a <$cdef(27)>Dartrix.

looking
at
me
like that?
<$comeff(4,20)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Oh, I know! <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,7)>You want to discuss aesthetics and the pursuit

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>You wanna make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)>? Huh. That’s cool.
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Guessing you came to me because you need the best,
most beautiful <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)> you’ve ever seen, yeah?

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,9)>I can take care of that for you, no problem.
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>But first, could you help me with something?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,827)><$voicel(4,5)>See, I’ve always wanted a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1541)>.
<$voicel(4,7)>Picture this: me, perfectly poised on my own personal
<$cdef(27)><$ifull(1541)>... I mean, talk about picturesque.
<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Think you could put a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1541)></color> near my place for me?

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Think you could put a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1541)> by my place? <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Then I’ll
teach you how to make a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)>.

<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! I was just chatting
with <$cdef(27)>Scorbunny.
<$voicel(1,6)>And when I told them about our plan to make <$cdef(27)>salad, they
seemed quite eager to learn more!
<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)>Why don’t you try talking to them before you make
that salad?

<$emotion(4,50)><$voicel(4,9)>Hey, I see you put a <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1541)> by my place. <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>It’s perfect!
<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>I can tell you paid attention to my preferences when you
put it together. Thanks.
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>As promised, I’ll tell you how to make a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1301)></color>.

<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>The trick is cutting your <$cdef(27)><$ifull(407)> with daring delicacy!
<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>Allow me to demonstrate, and watch these wings closely!
<$motion(4,816)><$voicel(4,9)>DA DA DAAAAAA!<$motion(4,815)><$motion(4,817)>

<$comeff(4,17)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Anyway, that should do it. Not that I’ve ever made one
myself before.
You came up with a <$cdef(27)>recipe</color> for a <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1301)></color>!

<$comeff(4,21)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,7)>My beautiful, claw-crafted <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1301)> are sure to

<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Oh, and if you need any <$cdef(27)><$ifull(407)> to make one, bring me

<$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$comeff(2,3)>It’s best to get a little help from someone the first time

a <$cdef(27)>salad together!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Oh, of course I’ll help! It’s gonna be so much fun making

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Hoho! Sounds like <$cdef(27)>Scorbunny really wants to eat a <$cdef(27)>salad!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>I think the two of you should make one, and then eat

<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,7)>I can’t wait anymore! Time to dig in!

<$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,17)><$voicel(4,6)>*crunch*

<$motion(4,19)><$comeff(4,13)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>It’s delicious! I mean...I knew it would be, but still!
Come on, <$cdef(27)>! You gotta try some!

<$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>What’s wrong? You should totally have some of this <$cdef(27)>salad

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Your <$cdef(27)><$sklfull(1)> became more powerful after you ate the

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I bet it’s because we worked really hard together to

<$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Preparing food makes it delicious, but I guess it also gives

<$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>I should go tell the <$cdef(27)>professor</color> and everyone!
